item.title: Mojtaba Effect: TTF Holds €50 as New Iran Leader Kills Reopening Hopes — HH Gains on Late-Season Cold
item.description: Mojtaba Khamenei's first act as Supreme Leader — vowing Hormuz stays shut indefinitely — removes the last near-term ceasefire catalyst. TTF holds €50 as the market prices duration, not resolution. The council validated 16 of 21 trade ideas, culling 5 duplicates and contradictions; the JKM-TTF widener and TTF Win-26 long remain highest conviction, while the €50 straddle captures the binary Hormuz outcome.

item.title: TTF au-dessus de €49 — La guerre iranienne maintient la prime de risque
item.description: Hormuz Day 12. TTF holds above 49 EUR, EU storage at 29 pct. The market is pricing duration, not resolution. Trade the refill squeeze.

item.title: Post-Crash Whiplash: TTF Reclaims €50 as IRGC Kills Ceasefire Euphoria
item.description: Post-crash whiplash defines the session: TTF touched €46.70 on ceasefire hopes before IRGC's blockade vow triggered a 5% reversal to €49.85. The council validated 11 trades from 21, culling 10 doublons and contradictions — the TTF Apr €48/€55 call spread (unanimous) and Win-26 outright long remain highest conviction, while the €50 straddle captures the binary Hormuz outcome.

item.title: TTF Holds €52 as Asian Demand Lifts JKM; HH Steady
item.description: Hormuz Week 2 with Qatar still dark and the April LNG ban six weeks away — the triple supply squeeze tightens. The council validated 10 trade ideas from 19, culling 9 duplicates and contradictions; the TTF Apr €55/€65 call spread and NBP-TTF locational play remain highest conviction, while the €48/€42 put is essential snap-back insurance.

item.title: TTF Steady at €52 Into Week 2 — Goldman Lifts Q2 Again as Hormuz Selective Blockade Hardens
item.description: Hormuz Week 2 with no ceasefire track, Qatar LNG still offline, and Putin's TurkStream threat adding a second supply front — the triple squeeze deepens into a structural refill crisis. The council validated 14 trade ideas from 23, culling 9 duplicates and out-of-scope plays; the JKM-TTF spread widener and Apr €55/€60 call spread remain highest-conviction, while the €48/€42 put hedge is essential insurance against the ceasefire snap-back.

item.title: TTF Holds €52 as Week 1 Panic Consolidates — HH Flat at $2.92 Despite Global Chaos
item.description: Iran war Week 2 with no ceasefire in sight, Qatar LNG infrastructure physically damaged, and Putin weaponising TurkStream ahead of the April 25 ban — the triple squeeze deepens into structural supply destruction. The council validated 12 trade ideas from 18, culling 6 duplicates and naked outright longs; the Apr €55/€65 call spread and JKM-TTF widener remain highest-conviction asymmetric plays, while the €45 put hedge is essential insurance against the snap-back.

item.title: Goldman Lifts TTF to €55 — Putin Threat Sparks Fresh 10% Spike Above €54
item.description: Hormuz Day 5 with no ceasefire in sight, Goldman's upward revision to €55, and Putin's pre-emptive gas withdrawal threat — the triple squeeze intensifies. The council validated 13 trade ideas from 21, culling 8 duplicates; the Apr €58/€72 call spread and JKM-TTF widener remain highest-conviction plays, while the 60 bcm injection mountain looms as Europe's defining challenge for 2026.
